answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The yarrow register is checked at draw time, kernel lists the eligible set, and zenith seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 10 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
